title: In-Context Bias Propagation in LLM-Based Tabular Data Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the propagation of statistical skews in prompt demonstrations by calculating Statistical Parity Difference (SPD), Equalized Odds (EOD), and distributional drift on generated synthetic data and downstream classifiers, focusing on racial groups in the Compas and Adult datasets.

Manipulating the proportion of gender-specific examples in in-context prompts and measuring the resulting Statistical Parity Difference (SPD) and conditional target label correlations in synthetic tabular data generated for the Adult dataset.

Injecting feature-aligned adversarial examples based on specific age brackets into the prompt and evaluating the downstream fairness (SPD) and utility degradation on healthcare datasets like Diabetes and Thyroid.

Analyzing the joint probability distributions of generated outputs and downstream fairness when prompts are adversarially skewed across intersecting protected attributes, specifically race and gender combinations in the Adult dataset.
